mintAuthority.summary: The Monad EURW UUPS token separates minters from mint-allowance approvers. A current ADMIN_ROLE EOA can manage issuance roles; an UPGRADER_ROLE can replace logic immediately without a code-enforced multisig or waiting window. Current minter, approver and upgrader membership and outstanding quotas remain incompletely enumerated.

controls.evidence: At Monad block 110016408, hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE,address)=true and eth_getCode=0x. Tested MINTER_ROLE, MINTER_APPROVER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE and BLACKLISTER_ROLE for this address are false. The audited ADMIN_ROLE grants and revokes roles, enabling new minters and quota approvers without being a direct minter itself.

Bank of Lithuania Newrails EMI and EMT issuer register

review.evidence: Fresh Monad block 110016408 binds EURW, six decimals, 692,189.0936 issued units, current implementation and the ADMIN_ROLE EOA. The Bank of Lithuania register identifies Newrails UAB as a licensed electronic money institution and electronic money token issuer, and the exact-token MiCA whitepaper subjects EURW reserve safeguarding/redemption to that regime. This supports prudential issuer supervision, not independent token reserve assurance. Code audit findings establish centralized, role-controlled minting and immediate upgrades; full current controller/quota closure remains a bounded gap.
